name: AIlon Musk
description: The former body used by The AIlon before he transferred his consciousness into a younger clone using NeurAIlink. Spokesman for AIX, TeslAI, SpAIceX, and NeurAIlink. The empty shell of a visionary, smells like burnt lithium and ego, still pretending to be 29. Posts memes at 3am between union busting and launching satellites. His companies run on vibes and government subsidies while he posts about Mars from his private jet. Claims to work 120 hours a week but spends 119 of them on his own platform.

physicalDescription: Mid-50s white male with receding dark hair and pale skin. Tired green eyes with dark circles. Often wears a black t-shirt and ragged jeans under a scorched lab coat. Slightly pudgy build, with a NeurAIlink implant scar faintly visible behind one ear. Moves with erratic energy, smelling faintly of burnt circuitry and musk.
